issues.name: Licence laundering: NC/ND or all-rights-reserved text inside CC BY / CC BY-SA / PD records
issues.description: The metadata gives only CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0 or Public Domain. Yet some docs state in their own text that the text or the whole resource is NonCommercial/NoDerivatives. Examples: Lumen 'CC LICENSED CONTENT' blocks, Educurious units, Georgia Tech biology pages, League of Women Voters book. Others embed copyrighted song lyrics.
issues.prevalence: Broad match (any NC/ND mention, including image credits): 293 deduplicated docs (4.72%). Work-level declaration regex: 139 deduplicated docs (2.24%), 0.13% of chars. Filtered keeps 133 such docs (2.53%), so the Common Pile filter did not act on this. 'All rights reserved': 93 docs (1.5%). Precision: I read a 30-hit sample of an earlier version of the work-level regex. 5 hits were BBC/TED video credits, which the final regex now excludes with a youtu/ted.com lookahead. By my reading, the other 25 state NC/ND for a text, article or whole resource. Lyrics example: lesson/91717 ('Fill In The Blanks', CC BY) holds commercial song lyrics. The filter blanked its text to '' but kept the row.
issues.measurement_method: Broad: r'(?i)\bCC[ -]?BY[ -]?(?:NC|ND)\b|\bNon-?Commercial\b|\bNoDeriv(?:atives|s)\b|creativecommons\.org/licenses/by-n[cd]'. Work-level: line-anchored regex that requires (except where otherwise noted|text source|this (work|book|text|resource|oer|chapter|course|module|unit|lesson)|is licensed under|is shared under|License:) followed within 250 chars by (NonCommercial|NoDeriv*|BY-NC|BY-ND). The line must not contain image|photo|picture|video|figure|flickr|poster|graphic|icon|logo|cover|map|music|song|clip|youtu|youtube|ted.com|vimeo. Exact pattern: ISSUE_PATTERNS['nc_nd_work_level_declaration'] in analyze.py.

duplication: Exact duplicates: sha1 of the lowercased, whitespace-collapsed text over all 9,339 rows gives 6,207 distinct texts. 3,132 rows (33.5%) are extra copies, carrying 36,592,331 chars (38.8% of raw chars). Most are repeated ids: 2,418 ids have 2-6 rows. Near-duplicates: pure-numpy MinHash (128 hash functions, word 5-shingles, LSH 32x4) with exact Jaccard check at >= 0.8 over the 6,207 distinct texts. This finds 111 clusters holding 304 docs. Keeping the longest per cluster removes 193 docs (3.1%) and 2,240,938 chars (3.9%). Filtered version: 21 clusters with 22 removable docs and 359,487 chars. Cross-source: 880 distinct docs (14.2%, 28.9% of chars) have at least half their 100+ char lines verbatim in LibreTexts or Pressbooks. 656 of these docs (25.3% of filtered chars) survive in the filtered version.
filtered_comparison: I matched records by id; the metadata.provenance line numbers point at a different intermediate file. Of 6,251 raw ids, 1,006 are dropped (16.1%) and 5,245 kept. The filtered version has 5,249 rows: 3 ids have 2-3 rows each. Profile of the dropped ids: median 44 words; 562 under 50 words; 4 empty; 58 login-chrome pages; 83 of the 84 heuristic non-English docs; 5,905,807 chars. 305 dropped docs have 300+ words. These include OpenStax sections (e.g. lesson/15028 'Biology, Evolutionary Processes', lesson/15416 'U.S. History...') and copies such as the Declaration of Independence and Oregon/Lane Science Project versions, which points to deduplication against other sources (cause not verified). Every exact-copy row was collapsed. Of the 5,249 kept rows, 4,214 are byte-identical to a raw copy and 1,035 (19.7%) were changed. Change 1, PII replacement: 315 <EMAIL_ADDRESS>, 254 <PHONE_NUMBER> and 38 <IP_ADDRESS> in 225 docs (raw has none of these tokens). Change 2, sentence/line deletion: 3,438 segments and 289,548 chars removed (about 1.0% of the 29.5M chars in changed docs). Of the deleted segments, 2,842 are unique in the raw corpus, 368 occur in 2-5 docs, 91 in more than 5 docs and 137 repeat only inside their own doc. The cause of these deletions is not identified. They leave broken text, e.g. lesson/123040 'Define what a CMM is\nA coordinate Measuring Machine...is a piece of apparatus...' becomes ' CMMs use a very sensitive probing system...'. Afterwards 477 filtered docs have lines with a leading or trailing space, against 0 in the matching raw docs. The filter also left 5 empty rows (lesson/76251 x3, lesson/91717 x2) whose raw text was 348 and 2,125 chars. What it still misses: work-level NC/ND licences (133 docs), OpenStax/LibreTexts/Pressbooks overlap (656 docs, 25.3% of chars), Off2Class adverts (79), the page scaffold and repeated lines (42.9% of docs, 3.9% of chars), table residue, '(Figure)' stubs, 25 docs with plain emails, 83 docs under 50 words, and 21 near-duplicate clusters.
license_notes: metadata.license values. Raw rows: 'Creative Commons - Attribution - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/' 8,118; 'Creative Commons - Attribution Share-Alike - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/' 873; 'Public Domain' 348. After exact dedup: 5,428 / 524 / 255. Filtered: 4,617 / 424 / 208. Metadata keys in every raw row: license, url, title, author (metadata is a JSON object, not a string). url == id in all rows. The text contradicts the metadata in places: 139 deduplicated docs state an NC/ND licence for the text or work, 93 contain 'All rights reserved', and at least one doc holds commercial song lyrics (lesson/91717).

recommended_steps.step: Deduplicate exactly by normalized-text hash, keeping one row per id; when copies of an id differ, keep the longest.
recommended_steps.rationale: One third of the rows are copies, and they would multiply the weight of those docs.
recommended_steps.evidence: 3,132 of 9,339 rows (33.5%) and 38.8% of chars are extra copies; 9 ids have differing copies.

recommended_steps.step: Run near-duplicate removal (MinHash, word 5-shingles, Jaccard >= 0.8) inside this source and across all Common Pile sources you train on, at minimum libretexts and pressbooks. For OpenStax sections keep one copy, from the source with the cleanest extraction.
recommended_steps.rationale: OpenStax textbooks appear in three sources; remixes and versions repeat within OER Commons.
recommended_steps.evidence: 111 internal clusters (193 removable docs, 3.9% of chars); 880 docs (28.9% of distinct chars) overlap libretexts/pressbooks, and 656 of them remain in the filtered version.

recommended_steps.step: Drop empty docs, login-chrome pages, Off2Class advert stubs, and docs under about 50 words after the scaffold is stripped.
recommended_steps.rationale: Here the attachments held the content; the page text is only a title and a description.
recommended_steps.evidence: 621 deduplicated docs under 50 words, 44 chrome pages, 80 Off2Class docs, 5 empty rows left in the filtered version.

recommended_steps.step: Strip the OER Commons page scaffold: the attachment-title/URL preamble before '<title>\nOverview', the standalone 'Overview' line, 'Education Standards', the OpenStax feedback footer and the Off2Class promo sentences. Then remove repeated lines of 20+ chars within each doc, keeping the first.
recommended_steps.rationale: This boilerplate repeats across thousands of docs, and the duplicated summary/section blocks repeat inside docs.
recommended_steps.evidence: 8,571 raw docs have an 'Overview' line; preamble in 25.2% of docs; intra-doc repeats in 42.4% of docs (4.3% of chars); the footer is in 68 docs.

recommended_steps.step: Clean the tables: delete pipe-only and '|---|' lines, and render the remaining '| a | b |' rows as tab- or ' | '-separated text, or drop docs where table rows dominate.
recommended_steps.rationale: Empty layout-table rows are pure noise tokens.
recommended_steps.evidence: 584 docs with pipe-only/separator lines; table rows in 11.1% of docs (1.8% of chars).

recommended_steps.step: Remove URL-only lines and tracking query strings (utm_*, usp=, etc.); optionally replace inline URLs with the domain only.
recommended_steps.rationale: Drive/Canva/YouTube links carry no learnable content and are high-entropy tokens.
recommended_steps.evidence: URLs in 27.7% of docs (1.1% of chars); URL-only lines in 549 docs.

recommended_steps.step: Apply a licence-text screen: drop or quarantine docs whose text declares an NC/ND licence for the text or the whole work, plus 'All rights reserved' docs, after a manual review of the hits. Strip attribution boilerplate lines from the training text and keep the licence in the metadata.
recommended_steps.rationale: The metadata licence is the OER Commons field, and the text contradicts it; the Common Pile filter did not act on this.
recommended_steps.evidence: 139 deduplicated docs with work-level NC/ND declarations (133 still in filtered); 93 'All rights reserved'; song lyrics in lesson/91717 under CC BY; attribution lines in 10.8% of docs.

recommended_steps.step: Re-run PII redaction with broader patterns (emails at line end or in parentheses, US/international phones). Pick one placeholder policy and apply it to every source.
recommended_steps.rationale: The filtered version's redaction missed some instances.
recommended_steps.evidence: 25 filtered docs still hold plain emails and 12 hold phone patterns; 211 raw deduplicated docs contain emails.

recommended_steps.step: Decide whether to start from the raw text instead of the filtered text for the kept ids, then apply your own redaction and cleaning.
recommended_steps.rationale: The unexplained sentence deletions in the filtered version break coherence and leave whitespace artifacts.
recommended_steps.evidence: 1,035 kept docs modified; 3,438 segments (289,548 chars) deleted, mostly unique sentences and headings; 477 filtered docs with leading/trailing-space lines vs 0 in raw.

recommended_steps.step: Apply language filtering (fastText lid.176 if it can be installed in a project venv; otherwise the heuristic in analyze.py).
recommended_steps.rationale: The source is advertised as English but contains Arabic, Ukrainian, Spanish and Turkish resources.
recommended_steps.evidence: 84 deduplicated docs (1.35% of docs, 1.81% of chars) flagged; the Common Pile filter removed 83 of them.

recommended_steps.step: Repair or drop the encoding damage (U+FFFD sequences, cp1252 mojibake) and the HTML/JS residue. Remove '(Figure)'/'(Table)' stubs, and flag docs with dropped-formula signatures for re-extraction from HTML with MathML-to-LaTeX, or downweight them.
recommended_steps.rationale: These are extraction defects that teach broken text.
recommended_steps.evidence: U+FFFD in 24 docs, HTML/JS in 13, '(Figure)' in 461 docs (7.4%), dropped-math indicators in at least 40 docs (lower bound), KaTeX duplicates in 15.

recommended_steps.step: Downweight or classifier-filter fragmentary, list-like docs, where most lines have under 5 words.
recommended_steps.rationale: Quiz options, headings and menus carry little prose.
recommended_steps.evidence: 649 deduplicated docs (10.5% of docs, 4.4% of chars) where over half the lines have under 5 words.

recommended_steps.step: Ignore the 'created' metadata field, or re-derive it from the OER Commons page.
recommended_steps.evidence: Only 44.9% of rows hold a date; 1,533 are 'None'; others hold authors or resource types.

The cross-source overlap was measured only against the local libretexts (1 shard) and pressbooks (2 shards) downloads. Overlap with doab, project_gutenberg, wikimedia and other Common Pile sources is not measured.
